description.description: free text: the frontmatter summary of what the standard defines.

link.description: free text: the canonical URL; the frontmatter schema declares `format: uri` and no pattern.

properties.description: The typed `## Properties` declarations, authored as the table or as the `sysml` fence — one artifact carries one form.

invariants.description: Formal clauses from an optional `## Invariants` section; clause text is carried beside the record, never parsed.

description:
Standard record (archetype `Standard`): the stable definition a spec's
`standards_alignment[]` points at.

The one type in this module that carries a typed declaration, because a
standard declares the properties a conforming artifact carries and the
invariants conformance requires. Both sections are optional, so every
Standard document that validates today keeps validating (FR-012).
